findings.evidence: Kyoto Cherry Blossom Season: When to Go in 2025
findings.message: The title names 2025 but it is already 2026; update the title and the facts, or retire the post.
March 27, 2027 2027 is a Saturday, not Friday.
'gion evening walk' is given two different dates in the same post; keep one.

findings.quote: Most years the trees reach full bloom somewhere between the last week of June and the first week of July.
findings.why: Kyoto's cherry blossoms peak in late March to early April, as the post's own TL;DR says; late June to early July is wrong and would send readers at the wrong time.
findings.fix: Change to the last week of March through the first week of April.

findings.quote: title: "Kyoto Cherry Blossom Season: When to Go in 2025"
findings.why: The title says 2025, which is already past, while the slug and the event dates refer to 2027.
findings.fix: Change the title year to 2027 to match the slug and the content.

findings.quote: A second evening walk, the Gion Evening Walk, is on Saturday, April 3, 2027.
findings.why: The text gives April 3, but the table gives April 10, 2027; readers could book or travel on the wrong date. April 3, 2027 is also a Saturday, so the table is the likely outlier, but this is unverifiable.
findings.fix: Confirm the date against the official source and use the same date in the text and the table.

findings.why: Ticket prices are stated without being tied to a source, and the listed link (kyoto-tourism.example/events/spring-lights) covers only Spring Lights, not the Gion walk. The fixed dates for 2027 are also unlikely to be announced this far ahead.
findings.fix: Cite the official page next to each price and date, or describe them as provisional and unconfirmed.

findings.why: No source in the Sources list covers the Gion Evening Walk, its date or its price.
findings.fix: Add an official source for this event or remove the date and price.

findings.quote: Both are run by the city tourism office, and tickets are sold in advance.
findings.why: The organiser claim is not backed by any listed source, and the Gion Evening Walk cannot be verified as an event run by the city tourism office.
findings.fix: Name the actual organiser with a source or remove the claim.

findings.why: It claims a verification with no evidence or method, and no source in the list supports the prices.
findings.fix: Remove the claim or link the pages checked and add a short methodology.

findings.quote: Use the Hanami Shuttle on busy weekends; it connects the main blossom spots and costs ¥600 per ride.
findings.why: I cannot verify that a 'Hanami Shuttle' exists in Kyoto, and its fare has no source.
findings.fix: Cite an official transport source for the service and fare, or remove it.

findings.quote: Maruyama Park in Higashiyama has a famous weeping cherry.
findings.why: The fact is generally correct (Maruyama Park's weeping cherry), but it is unsourced.

findings.quote: Trains are quicker on weekdays than on peak weekends.
findings.why: The claim is vague and generic filler; trains do not run faster on weekdays.
findings.fix: Say that roads and buses are more crowded on weekends, or remove the line.
